thread:
Harper: Ops wants autoswitch fallback on for rollout-v2 tomorrow. Quick UX + telemetry sync so we don't explode the audit index.
Noor: Two parts: (A) keep sampled decision rows for the console digest; (B) full audit only for operator-driven actions (hold/stick) and explicit replays.
Gabe: For sampling, front-load it: 15% first 20m then exponential decay to 0.5% over 12h. captures early flakiness without long-term noise.
Yuki: Agreed. Also standardize reason tags. Current numeric codes are useless. Suggest enum: latency_p95, upstream_5xx, quota_exceeded, model_error, cold_start.
Harper: UI idea: show a small pill on rollout card `soft  latency_p95  3%` where % is observed fallback rate. Click expands a sampled digest (counts + top reason + one example trace).
Noor: Operator controls: quick snooze (5m/30m/2h) on the card (no note), persistent hold in operator flyout requires a short rationale and must generate a full audit row with actor + TTL.
Gabe: Prevent flip-flopping by adding per-rollout cooldowns for hold: sequence 0 -> 10m -> 1h -> 4h. record cooldown level and previous policy id in the audit event.
Yuki: Telemetry fields to add on decision events: decision_id, rollout_id, ts, fallback_reason, degrade_mode, sampled:true/false, override_action, override_actor, override_note, override_ttl, policy_revision, prev_route_id, fallback_variant_id. Keep sampled decisions lightweight but include trace_id pointer.
rollout-bot: Deploy note: canary rollout v2-autoswitch scheduled by @Harper at 1763210060  monitoring channels subscribed.
Harper: Action items: Noor mock pill + digest, Gabe implement sampling decay and cooldown enforcement, Yuki publish telemetry schema and migration notes. Gate flip until mocks land.
Noor: I'll put a quick Figma card in #design by EOD.
Gabe: PR for sampling + cooldown by 3pm.
Yuki: Schema diff and retention plan this afternoon.
Harper: If mocks look ok we enable tomorrow, otherwise we delay. Sound good? :+1:
